title: Batch C: the other five leads' faces
summary: Sela, Juno, Silas, Bram and Ione: a head turnaround each, then every expression in its three views. All passed my review; eleven pages were resized on this PC. Kaito's three-quarter body sheet is at the top as the layout test for every body sheet.

items.name: Kaito, three-quarter body (layout test)
items.take: take 2 (gauntlet added in the back-left view)

zooms.label: Front three-quarters
zooms.why: Streak near in the right one; gauntlet and hand mark on his right arm

zooms.label: Back three-quarters
zooms.why: Gauntlet on his right arm in both; back-view hands from behind

notes: The first of the three-quarter body sheets; every other sheet follows this layout once you pass it
